title: Watch redesign polish: health vs needs-you, titles at 80 columns, colour, group spacing
description: Follow-ups the operator accepted when merging ymf (PR #272, 2026-10-10), found reading its golden frames and screenshots (docs/design/watch-redesign-2026-10/): the health line contradicts the needs-you box; tick titles are truncated at 80 columns; the screenshots show no colour; the NOW/DONE/UP NEXT/HELD groups run together.
acceptance_criteria:
[A1] With anything in needs-you, the health line no longer reads healthy (e.g. 'paused · needs you').
[A2] At 80x24 a tick title gets the width before the status: the busy scenario shows 'order-feed service skeleton' in full or nearly, the status shortens or wraps instead.
[A3] The dashboard uses its colour accents on a colour terminal (green done, amber in progress, red failed/held, dim pending), and the committed screenshots show them.
[A4] A blank line separates the groups and the phase track, within 80x24 for the five scenarios.
[A5] Golden frames and screenshots updated; make gate passes and CI is green.
